description: Docker engine capacity, running containers, health checks, lifecycle and per-container resource use from Telegraf.

targets.query:
import "date"

recent = date.sub(d: 10m, from: v.timeRangeStop)
start = if v.timeRangeStart > recent then v.timeRangeStart else recent

from(bucket: "${telegraf_bucket}")
  |> range(start: start, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "n_cpus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.engine_host =~ /^${engine:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["engine_host"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Container lifecycle
panels.description: Latest Telegraf lifecycle data in the final 10 minutes. Restarts are the count for the current container instance.

targets.query:
import "date"

recent = date.sub(d: 10m, from: v.timeRangeStop)
start = if v.timeRangeStart > recent then v.timeRangeStart else recent

from(bucket: "${telegraf_bucket}")
  |> range(start: start, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "restart_count" or r._field == "uptime_ns" or r._field == "oomkilled" or r._field == "exitcode")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.engine_host =~ /^${engine:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: int(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["engine_host", "container_name", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "engine_host", "container_name", "container_status"],
           columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.restart_count and exists r.oomkilled and exists r.exitcode and exists r.uptime_ns)
  |> sort(columns: ["oomkilled", "restart_count"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Container: r.container_name, Engine: r.engine_host, State: r.container_status,
      Restarts: r.restart_count, Uptime: if r.container_status == "running" then float(v: r.uptime_ns) / 1000000000.0 else 0.0,
      "Exit code": r.exitcode, OOM: if r.oomkilled == 1 then "Yes" else "No"}))

from(bucket: "${telegraf_bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.engine_host =~ /^${engine:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cpu == "cpu-total")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_host", "container_name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${telegraf_bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_blkio")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "io_service_bytes_recursive_read")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.engine_host =~ /^${engine:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.container_name =~ /^${container:regex}$/)

  |> set(key: "direction", value: "read")
  |> group(columns: ["engine_host", "container_name", "direction"])
